fusions.name: Poling Off
fusions.desc: Sets the staff against a target up to 4 tiles away and shoves off. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Snapped Branches
fusions.desc: Snaps 3 branches off the growth on the staff and throws them in a spread out to 5 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Reef on the Piling
fusions.desc: Drives the staff in where you stand for 14 seconds and a reef head grows over it. Its polyps sting an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barnacled Haft
fusions.desc: Whenever you strike an enemy, the reef on the staff feeds you: you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
